name: headline_ballots
title: All Elections: Ballots
description: Candidate-level results, party affiliations, and demographic details for every contest from 1955-present.

columns.name: date
columns.title: Date
columns.description: [Date] Date of polling day in YYYY-MM-DD format

columns.name: election
columns.title: Election
columns.description: [String] Election identifier, e.g. GE-15, SE-15, By-Election

columns.name: state
columns.title: State
columns.description: [String] Name of state where the contest took place

columns.name: seat
columns.title: Constituency
columns.description: [String] Code (P.xxX or N.xxX) and name of the constituency

columns.name: ballot_order
columns.title: Ballot Order
columns.description: [Integer] The candidate's position on the ballot paper

columns.name: candidate_uid
columns.title: Candidate UID
columns.description: [String] Unique identifier for the candidate

columns.name: name_on_ballot
columns.title: Name On Ballot
columns.description: [String] Candidate's name as it appeared on the ballot paper

columns.name: name
columns.title: Candidate Name
columns.description: [String] Candidate's harmonised name

columns.name: sex
columns.title: Sex
columns.description: [String] Sex of candidate; 'M' for male, 'F' for female

columns.name: ethnicity
columns.title: Ethnicity
columns.description: [String] Ethnicity of candidate (e.g. 'Malay', 'Chinese', etc.)

columns.name: age
columns.title: Age
columns.description: [Integer] Age of candidate in years at time of election (-1 if missing)

columns.name: party_on_ballot
columns.title: Party On Ballot
columns.description: [String] Short/abbreviated party name as it appeared on the ballot paper

columns.name: party_uid
columns.title: Party UID
columns.description: [String] Unique party identifier (code)

columns.name: party
columns.title: Party
columns.description: [String] Full official party name

columns.name: coalition_uid
columns.title: Coalition UID
columns.description: [Integer] Numeric identifier for the coalition (if any). 0 if no coalition

columns.name: coalition
columns.title: Coalition
columns.description: [String] Coalition name or 'ALONE' if not in a coalition

columns.name: votes
columns.title: Votes
columns.description: [Integer] Number of votes received by the candidate

columns.name: votes_perc
columns.title: Vote Percentage
columns.description: [Float] Percentage of valid votes received by the candidate

columns.name: rank
columns.title: Rank
columns.description: [Integer] Placing/rank of candidate in contest (1 = winner, 2 = second place, and so on)

columns.name: result
columns.title: Result
columns.description: [String] Short outcome: 'won', 'won_uncontested', 'lost', or 'lost_deposit'

columns.title: State Seat

columns.title: Polling District (Voter Roll)
